Arcade map identification thumbnails

These seven 225 x 150 WebP images identify the supported StarCraft II Arcade
maps. They were converted from their published Battle.net cache thumbnails,
with the map identity and thumbnail content hash verified locally. They are
displayed solely as map-selection artwork, at the user's explicit request.

Unity: 1/293070
Liberty: 1/345748
Mineralz Survival 2: 1/369775
Reign of Chaos: 1/326447
Fallen World New Beginning: 1/379420
MineralZ Evolution Updated: 1/344126
Probes vs Zealot 2 Updated: 1/308522

Artwork belongs to its respective map creators and/or Blizzard Entertainment;
it is not covered by the editor's code license. This project is independent
and does not claim endorsement. A thumbnail does not change the supported
bank version shown on each profile.
